ios.desc:
Easy location tracking makes sure you can keep track of your friends and family. 

Share your live location with to stay in touch on the move. Remain in control of your location by choosing how long to share for and with whom.

As a dedicated GPS tracker, Zocal’s location sharing is specifically optimized for your battery. Most users report minimal battery usage when Zocal is working in the background, enabling you to share location for however long you wish, with whoever you want without stress. 

With easy location sharing, stay connected wherever you go with real-time location-based messaging.
